authorityCeiling.basis: Boundary: "Observation does not auto-promote changes." N-Observer measures only; it cannot promote, so its ceiling is observe.
Boundary quote: "Observation does not auto-promote changes." Measuring without promoting maps to observe in the Section 3.3 authority vocabulary.

capabilityFamilies.basis: Role quote: "Measures traces, loops, cost, failure concentration, and state transitions."

lifecycleStages.basis: Section 3.3 defines lifecycleMask as workflow stage and completion state but names no stages. The paper assigns no lifecycle stages to N-Observer.

memoryPlanes.basis: Role quote: "Measures traces." A trace is an episodic record of what happened, which maps to the episodic plane in the Section 3.3 memory vocabulary.

outputClasses.basis: Role quote: "Measures traces, loops, cost, failure concentration, and state transitions." Recorded measurements are artifacts.

permittedRoutes.basis: The paper defines routeMask semantics in Sections 3.2 and 3.3 but names no per-organ routes for N-Observer.

paperRole: Measures traces, loops, cost, failure concentration, and state transitions.
paperSource: N-Cell position paper, Section 4 mapping table, https://ncell-position-paper.pages.dev/, accessed 2026-11-14.
